title: ChipMate Architecture Ratchet Allowlist
description: Baseline exception list for ChipMate-owned domain architecture boundaries and state ratchets. Upstream-owned shared opencode files are exempt to prevent upstream merge conflicts. As ChipMate legacy sites are refactored into clean Effect layers, decrement counts or remove entries to lock in progress.

chipmate-instance-state-singletons.description: Legacy InstanceState.make usages in ChipMate-owned code (packages/opencode/src/chipmate/**, packages/opencode/src/chipmate-*/**). Target: encapsulate in scoped Effect Services in packages/core.

chipmate-database-constructors.description: Direct new Database() / new DatabaseSync() instantiations in ChipMate-owned code. Target: all persistence routes through core Database.Service.

chipmate-tool-process-env.description: Direct process.env reads in ChipMate-owned tools. Target: pass configuration explicitly via Tool.Context or Env.Service.
